svg.aria-label: PolyWire architecture: twelve client protocols -- OraWire, MySQL, SQL Server, Postgres wire, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Amazon SQS, gRPC, MCP, OpenSearch, InfluxDB, and GraphDB (Neo4j Bolt+Cypher) -- feed one shared eight-stage pipeline: Frontends, FirewallStage, RouterStage, QosControlStage, DialectTranslationStage, RollupStage, CacheStage, and StatsCollectorStage, backed by a Postgres control plane, executing against a primary Postgres and any number of additional shards.
svg.text: Secure, scalable, intelligent Postgres gateway for the enterprise.

g.text: Backed by embedded Ignite -- opt-in per table, TTL-based
Cypher) now speak real Postgres too

svg.text: PolyWire v1 -- twelve client-facing wire protocols, one real Postgres underneath.
